title: Conveyancing Assistant
description:
Conveyancing Assistant Plymouth
£25,000 to £27,000 per annum In-office
About the role
DK Recruitment is delighted to be working with a well-established law firm in Plymouth on the search for a Conveyancing Assistant to join its busy property team. This is a great opportunity for someone organised and detail-focused to support experienced fee earners and build their career in conveyancing.

Key responsibilities
- Supporting fee earners with conveyancing files from instruction through to completion
- Opening new matters, carrying out ID and source of funds checks, and preparing client care documentation
- Preparing contract packs and ordering searches
- Liaising with clients, estate agents, lenders and other solicitors by phone and email
- Assisting with completions, post-completion work, SDLT returns and Land Registry applications
- Keeping files and case management records accurate and up to date

What our client is looking for
- Previous experience in a conveyancing or legal support role (preferred)
- Excellent organisation and time management skills
- Strong attention to detail and accuracy
- Clear, friendly communication skills
- The ability to work well under pressure in a fast-paced team

What s on offer
- A salary of £25,000 to £27,000 per annum
- An in-office role within a supportive, friendly team
- The opportunity to develop your conveyancing skills alongside experienced fee earners

title: Conveyancing Paralegal
description:

Conveyancing Paralegal
Competitive salary & generous benefits
Honiton Full-time Office-based
Are you a Conveyancing Paralegal or Conveyancing Assistant looking for your next role?
SJC Partners is working with an established law firm seeking an experienced Conveyancing Paralegal to join its residential property team. You'll help progress transactions within a friendly, professional environment.

To apply, send your CV to Paige at SJC Partners, or get in touch for a confidential chat.

title: Legal Assistant
description:
Legal Assistant Devon £25,000 + DOE Are you a property Legal Assistant looking to move to a welcoming firm where you can develop your career? If so, please contact Theresa on or email with your CV. JOB REF: 5845

THE OPPORTUNITY:
An excellent opportunity has arisen for an experienced Property Legal Assistant to join a friendly and supportive conveyancing team. The organisation prides itself on fostering a positive workplace culture, with a strong emphasis on employee wellbeing, professional development, and long-term career progression.

THE ROLE:
This is a full-time, office-based position suited to someone with a thorough understanding of the residential conveyancing process, from initial instruction through to completion.
Your responsibilities will include managing new client instructions, preparing fee estimates and client care documentation, completing onboarding and source of funds checks, issuing contract packs, and arranging property searches.
You will also liaise with clients by telephone and email, manage post-exchange requirements, prepare completion statements, and coordinate completions, including requesting mortgage funds and arranging payments. Further duties include post-completion matters, property registrations and SDLT returns.
The successful candidate will have excellent interpersonal and organisational skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.

WHAT'S ON OFFER?
A competitive salary and attractive benefits package, including:
Health, Wellbeing & Development
- Enhanced annual leave entitlement, with additional holiday for long service.
- Company pension scheme.
- Employee Assistance Programme and mental health support.
- Modern, comfortable office facilities.
- Coaching and mentoring to support your professional development.
- Discounts on legal services.

WORKING ARRANGEMENTS:
- Job type: Full-time, permanent.
- Working pattern: Monday to Friday, with no weekend work.
- Location: Office-based.
If you're an experienced Property Legal Assistant looking for a positive working environment, opportunities to develop and a strong focus on work-life balance, this could be the ideal next step in your career.

HOW TO APPLY:
Contact Theresa at eNL on or email with your CV, or simply call for a confidential discussion.

eNL will never share your CV with a third party without your express permission. As part of our candidate care process, we aim to respond to all applications in 7 days. If you have not been contacted within this timescale, your application has been unsuccessful on this occasion. Please note our advertisements use PQE/salary levels purely as a guide.

At eNL we value diversity and inclusion. We want to attract people at all levels and encourage applications from all suitably qualified candidates whatever your ethnicity, religion, age, physical or mental disability, sexual orientation, gender identity or any other characteristics protected by law in the jurisdictions in which we operate.

title: Legal Assistant (Law Graduate Opportunity)
description:
Locations: Exeter, Plymouth or Torbay (flexible office base)
Salary: 24,000 - 25,000 + Excellent Benefits
Job Type: Full Time, Permanent

Kick-Start Your Legal Career with One of the South West's Leading Law Firms

An exciting opportunity has arisen for a motivated and ambitious Law Graduate to join a highly regarded and well-established legal practice with offices across Exeter, Plymouth and Torbay .

This is an ideal opportunity for a recent Law Graduate or someone looking to take their first step into the legal profession. You'll gain exposure to a broad range of legal work whilst supporting experienced Solicitors and Fee Earners within a firm renowned for delivering exceptional client service and legal expertise across the South West.

Offering genuine career progression, ongoing training and mentoring, this role provides an excellent platform for those looking to develop a long-term career within the legal sector.

The Role

As a Legal Assistant, you will provide administrative and client support across various practice areas, helping to ensure the smooth running of legal matters from instruction through to completion.

Key responsibilities will include:
- Supporting Solicitors and Fee Earners with day-to-day case administration
- Liaising with clients via telephone, email and in person
- Managing legal documents, correspondence and filing systems
- Opening new client files and undertaking compliance checks
- Preparing legal documentation and court bundles
- Scheduling appointments and managing diaries
- Updating case management systems accurately
- Assisting with general office and administrative duties
- Maintaining high levels of client care and confidentiality

About You

Applicants should possess:
- A Law degree (LLB) or equivalent legal qualification
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills
- Strong administration and organisational abilities
- A professional and confident telephone manner
- High attention to detail
- Good IT skills, including Microsoft Office
- The ability to prioritise workload and work effectively within a busy team
- A positive attitude and genuine interest in developing a career within law

Previous legal administration, customer service or office experience would be advantageous but is not essential.

What's on Offer?
- Salary of 24,000 - 25,000
- Flexible office location across Exeter, Plymouth or Torbay
- Excellent training and development opportunities
- Clear career progression pathways
- Pension scheme
- Generous annual leave entitlement
- Healthcare and wellbeing initiatives
- Employee assistance programme
- Life assurance
- Social events and team activities
- Supportive and collaborative working environment

The Firm

This highly respected South West law firm has built an outstanding reputation for delivering expert legal advice and exceptional client service. With a strong regional presence and multiple offices across Devon, they continue to attract high-quality work and provide excellent opportunities for employees to develop and progress their careers within a supportive and professional environment.

If you're a Law Graduate looking to secure your first role within a prestigious legal practice and build a successful long-term career, Tania at Lockhart Recruitment would love to hear from you.
